beats.say: Why can you not find GTA Online in GTA 6? You did not miss a menu. It is not out yet.
beats.screen: You scrolling the GTA 6 pause menu, no Online option

beats.say: GTA 6 launched on November 19th without the new Online mode.
Rockstar has not given it a date.
Bloomberg's Jason Schreier has reported it is expected in 2027. Rockstar has not confirmed that.
So nothing is wrong with your copy. Online is coming, the reporting says 2027, and it is not dated.
Follow and you will hear it the day it gets a date.
